entities.summary: Philip of Alençon  was a French cardinal who was a member of the Valois dynasty. He was the second son of Count Charles II of Alençon, who was killed in the Battle of Crécy, and of Maria de La Cerda y de Lara. He was the younger brother of Count Charles III of Alençon.
